readiness_evidence: Hosted replay: on 19/10/26 the saved-booking merge ran on a Superagent when 0.7.0 first linked /app/.agents: the old nested folders from earlier runs were kept as *.before-prepare-* copies, the real session file with the earlier bookings was kept, and the earlier Oct 20 booking was found again after a real sandbox restart. The host-variable path (BOOKING_AGENT_PERSISTENT_ROOT) was not exercised, because this host does not set it; it is covered by tests only.

No request or response exchanged with the registry or with businesses changes. The saved booking file keeps format 2 and no new field is added; two files that held different bookings are now combined instead of one hiding the other.
user_summary: Your bookings and sign-in now survive a restart on assistants that keep a folder between sessions, without anyone having to set it up.
